question.prompt: Name a Kanye West song from Graduation, including bonus tracks and remixes.

answers.evidence: The discography lists Barry Bonds as a Graduation song featuring Lil Wayne.
Big Brother is listed as originally released on Graduation.
Bittersweet Poetry is listed on the Japanese edition of Graduation.
Can't Tell Me Nothing is listed as originally released on Graduation.
The discography separately lists the Jeezy remix of Can't Tell Me Nothing under Graduation.
Champion is listed as a Graduation song.
Drunk and Hot Girls is listed as a Graduation song featuring Mos Def.
Everything I Am is listed as a Graduation song featuring DJ Premier.
Flashing Lights is listed as a Graduation song featuring Dwele.
The Glory is listed as originally released on Graduation.
Good Life is listed as a Graduation song featuring T-Pain.
Good Morning is listed as originally released on Graduation.
Good Night is listed on the iTunes, UK and Japanese editions of Graduation.
Homecoming is listed as a Graduation song featuring Chris Martin.
I Wonder is listed as originally released on Graduation.
Stronger is listed as originally released on Graduation.
The Andrew Dawson remix of Stronger is separately listed under Graduation.
The A-Trak remix of Stronger is separately listed under Graduation.

question.explanation: These songs are listed in the provided discography as originally released on Graduation or one of its special editions. Bonus tracks and separately listed remixes count.
